from crm.models import Customer

def test_customer_has_required_persistence_fields() -> None:
    assert Customer._meta.get_field('first_name').max_length == 100
    assert Customer._meta.get_field('last_name').max_length == 100
    assert Customer._meta.get_field('email').max_length == 254
    assert Customer._meta.get_field('phone').max_length == 40
